description: More business in the accounts the rep already has: for each of their customers (marked on MedaRep), the procedures they do that one of the rep's lines covers (my_lines) where that line's company is not already the one most engaged with them for those products, with their Medicare cases, who engages them for those products now and how deeply, and why it ranks. Give one customer's NPI for theirs, or none for the best across all customers. Needs saved lines and marked customers.

npi.description: One customer's 10-digit NPI. Omit for the best across all customers.
